moments.title: Strictly's First Live Dance
moments.blurb: The 17th series of Strictly Come Dancing goes live for the first time tonight, with all 15 celebrity couples taking to the ballroom.

angles.name: Tonight's Glitz
angles.copy: It's finally here! The Strictly Come Dancing ballroom opens for its first live show of the series tonight. Who are you rooting for?

angles.name: No Elimination Yet
angles.copy: No public vote or elimination this week, so the couples can dance freely! Catch the first live performances on Strictly tonight.

moments.title: Great British Bake Off: Week 2
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off continues with its second episode of the 17th series this Tuesday, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson.

angles.name: Bake Off Returns
angles.copy: Get ready for more soggy bottoms and showstoppers! The Great British Bake Off is back for its second helping this Tuesday.

angles.name: New Judge Impact
angles.copy: How will new judge Nigella Lawson shake up the tent this week? Catch the second episode of Bake Off on Channel 4.

moments.title: Elton John Opens Apple Music Hall
moments.blurb: Sir Elton John will be the first artist to perform at the new Apple Music Hall in London's Battersea Power Station on Monday, September 28.

angles.name: Rocket Man in London
angles.copy: A new venue and a legend to open it! Elton John kicks off the Apple Music Hall in London this Monday. What a way to start!

angles.name: Iconic Opening
angles.copy: London's newest music venue, the Apple Music Hall, opens its doors with none other than Sir Elton John headlining. History in the making this Monday!

moments.title: Manchester Live Music Tonight
moments.blurb: Manchester's music scene is buzzing tonight with Megan Moroney at O2 Apollo, Anuv Jain and The Maine at Manchester Academy, Mica Millar at New Century Hall, and Homobloc Festival.

angles.name: Manchester's Live Saturday
angles.copy: Huge night for live music in Manchester! Megan Moroney, Anuv Jain, The Maine, Mica Millar & Homobloc Festival are all happening tonight. Where are you heading?

angles.name: Homobloc Is Back
angles.copy: Homobloc Festival takes over Manchester today! Get ready for an incredible day of electronic music.

moments.title: Josh Levi Live in Manchester
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Josh Levi brings his live show to The Lodge in Manchester tomorrow, Sunday, September 27.

angles.name: Sunday Night Pop
angles.copy: Kick off your Sunday night with Josh Levi! He's live in Manchester tomorrow at The Lodge.

angles.name: Manchester Spotlight
angles.copy: Rising star Josh Levi hits Manchester tomorrow for a must-see gig at The Lodge. Don't miss out!

moments.title: Niall Horan's London O2 Shows
moments.blurb: Niall Horan is set to wrap up his UK tour with two major shows at The O2 in London at the beginning of October, likely October 2nd and 3rd.

angles.name: Niall in the Capital
angles.copy: Niall Horan is bringing his Dinner Party Live On Tour to London's O2 Arena early next week! Who's got tickets?

angles.name: O2 Arena Buzz
angles.copy: The O2 is buzzing for Niall Horan as he plays two massive shows at the start of October. It's going to be huge!

moments.title: Ellie Goulding's 'I Know Too Much'
moments.blurb: Ellie Goulding released her sixth studio album, 'I Know Too Much', yesterday, featuring her signature pop and electronic sounds.

angles.name: New Ellie Music
angles.copy: Ellie Goulding dropped her brand new album 'I Know Too Much' yesterday! What are your first impressions?

angles.name: Weekend Listen
angles.copy: Your soundtrack for the weekend just got an upgrade. Stream Ellie Goulding's new album 'I Know Too Much' now!

moments.title: Carly Rae Jepsen's 'Day and Night'
moments.blurb: Pop sensation Carly Rae Jepsen released her ambitious double album 'Day and Night' yesterday, featuring 24 new tracks.

angles.name: Double Album Drop
angles.copy: Carly Rae Jepsen just blessed us with a double album, 'Day and Night'! That's 24 new tracks to dive into. What's your favourite side: Day or Night?

angles.name: Pop Perfection
angles.copy: More Carly Rae Jepsen is always a good thing! Her new double album 'Day and Night' is out now.

moments.title: Chaka Khan's 'Chakzilla'
moments.blurb: The legendary Chaka Khan released her new album 'Chakzilla' yesterday, her first full-length release since 2019.

angles.name: Chaka's Back!
angles.copy: Queen of Funk Chaka Khan has a brand new album out called 'Chakzilla'! Get your groove on this weekend.

angles.name: Legendary Release
angles.copy: Chaka Khan's first album in seven years is here! 'Chakzilla' dropped yesterday, bringing her powerful vocals and dance influences.

moments.title: Happy 42nd, Avril Lavigne
moments.blurb: Canadian pop-punk icon Avril Lavigne turns 42 tomorrow, September 27.

angles.name: Sk8er Girl Turns 42
angles.copy: Can you believe Avril Lavigne turns 42 tomorrow?! Still rocking it after all these years. What's your favourite Avril track?

angles.name: Pop-Punk Princess
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 42nd birthday to the one and only Avril Lavigne tomorrow! Pop-punk wouldn't be the same without her.

moments.title: Happy 44th, Lil Wayne
moments.blurb: Influential American rapper Lil Wayne celebrates his 44th birthday tomorrow, September 27.

angles.name: Weezy F. Baby Turns 44
angles.copy: Happy 44th birthday to the legendary Lil Wayne tomorrow! Drop your favourite Weezy lyric below.

angles.name: Rap Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: One of the most influential rappers of his generation, Lil Wayne, turns 44 tomorrow. Celebrate with his biggest hits!

moments.title: Happy 48th, Brad Arnold
moments.blurb: Brad Arnold, lead singer of the rock band 3 Doors Down, turns 48 tomorrow, September 27.

angles.name: 3 Doors Down Frontman
angles.copy: Tomorrow, 3 Doors Down frontman Brad Arnold celebrates his 48th birthday! What's your favourite track from the band?

angles.name: Kryptonite Singer
angles.copy: Happy 48th to Brad Arnold, the voice behind 'Kryptonite' and many more 3 Doors Down hits, celebrating his birthday tomorrow.

moments.title: Happy 44th, St. Vincent
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning musician Annie Clark, known as St. Vincent, celebrates her 44th birthday on Monday, September 28.

angles.name: Art-Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 44th birthday to the incredibly talented St. Vincent (Annie Clark) this Monday! What's your favourite album?

angles.name: Musical Visionary
angles.copy: St. Vincent, a true musical visionary, turns 44 on Monday! Celebrate her unique sound and incredible career.

moments.title: Happy 79th, Brian Johnson
moments.blurb: AC/DC frontman Brian Johnson will celebrate his 79th birthday on Tuesday, October 5.

angles.name: AC/DC Legend Turns 79
angles.copy: Get ready to rock! AC/DC's iconic frontman, Brian Johnson, turns 79 this Tuesday. What's your ultimate AC/DC anthem?

angles.name: Still Shaking The Foundations
angles.copy: A very happy 79th birthday to Brian Johnson from AC/DC on October 5th! The man, the legend, the voice.

moments.title: Happy 75th, Bob Geldof
moments.blurb: Musician, activist, and Boomtown Rats frontman Bob Geldof celebrates his 75th birthday on Tuesday, October 5.

angles.name: Sir Bob Turns 75
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Bob Geldof this Tuesday! Musician, activist, and a true icon. What's your favourite Boomtown Rats song?

angles.name: Legendary Activist
angles.copy: On October 5th, we're celebrating Bob Geldof's 75th birthday. From 'I Don't Like Mondays' to Band Aid, a life of impact.

moments.title: Happy 83rd, Steve Miller
moments.blurb: Blues rock legend Steve Miller, founder of the Steve Miller Band, turns 83 on Tuesday, October 5.

angles.name: Fly Like An Eagle
angles.copy: The Space Cowboy himself, Steve Miller, celebrates his 83rd birthday this Tuesday! What's your go-to Steve Miller Band track?

angles.name: Blues Rock Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Steve Miller on October 5th! Still a 'Joker' in the pack.
